# Pinned runtime dependencies for the vendored mailon package.
# Versions locked to the set validated on prod (<primary-node>, CPython 3.13.14,
# aarch64) — see docs/guide/기관메일-인터페이스.md. Exact pins (==) keep the
# scoped venv reproducible across redeploys (Oracle risk #2: `>=` ranges can
# resolve to a different environment under the same skill digest).
#
# Direct dependencies used by mailon/:
#   pyotp          — mailon/totp.py  (RFC 6238 TOTP)
#   python-dotenv  — mailon/config.py (optional .env load; secrets normally
#                    arrive via subprocess env with override=False)
#   beautifulsoup4 — mailon/scraper.py (email HTML extraction)
#   lxml           — beautifulsoup4 parser backend ("lxml"); the only
#                    C-extension, which is why a scoped venv is required.
pyotp==2.10.0
python-dotenv==1.2.2
beautifulsoup4==4.15.0
lxml==6.1.1

# Transitive (pinned for reproducibility):
soupsieve==2.8.4
typing_extensions==4.16.0
